## Load libraries

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(ggsci)
library(dplyr)
```

## Process samples

```{r}
setwd()

phylo = readRDS("data/Phylo_public.rds")
meta = samdat_tbl(phylo)

#look at metadata
summarize_phyloseq(phylo)

table(meta$Source)
table(meta$Plate, meta$case_control)
```

Add sample library size.

```{r}
depth = data.frame(lib_size = sample_sums(phylo))
depth$SampleID = rownames(depth)
depth$SampleID = sub('.', '', depth$SampleID)

phylo = ps_join(x = phylo, y = depth, by = "SampleID", type = "inner", match_sample_names = NULL)

sample_data(phylo)$subject = as.factor(sample_data(phylo)$subject)
```

```{r}
unique(meta$Source)
unique(meta$Amp.Status)

phylo_r = phylo |> ps_filter(Source == "rectum") 
temp = sample_data(phylo_r)
unique(temp$Subject.ID)

colSums(table(temp$Subject.ID, temp$case_control) != 0) #check sample size

phylo_r = phylo_r |> ps_filter(Amp.Status == "Amp")
meta_r = samdat_tbl(phylo_r)
unique(meta_r$Subject.ID)

colSums(table(meta_r$Subject.ID, meta_r$case_control) != 0) #check sample size

# List the subjects who were lost after filtering for amplification
unique(temp$Subject.ID[!(temp$Subject.ID %in% meta_r$Subject.ID)])
```

Merge and filter.

```{r}
merged_r = merge_samples(phylo_r, "subject", fun = sum)

# Keep subject IDs from the merged phyloseq object
sample_data(merged_r)$Subject.ID = sample_names(merged_r)

# Add corrected patient demographics metadata
newdata = read_xlsx(
 "data/Newdata_endo_pain.xlsx",col_names = T, sheet =1)

splits = strsplit(newdata$`Study ID`, split = "-")
splits = lapply(splits, head, 2)
newdata$Subject.ID = sapply(splits, paste, collapse = "")


# Keep all clinical variables from the corrected demographics sheet
newdata = newdata |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    case_control_new = `case vs control`,
    paratubal_cysts_new = `Paratubal Cysts`,
    Gravidity_new = Graviditity,
    Age_new = `Age at surgery`,
    parity_status_new= `Parity status`,
    parity_new = Parity,
    BMI_new = BMI,
    stage_new = stage,
    Severity_new = Severity,
    Endosalpingiosis_new = Endosalpingiosis,
    Adenomyosis_new = Adenomyosis,
    Fibroids_new = Fibroids,
    pain_1st_level_new = pain_1st_level,
    abnormal_bleeding_new = Abnormal_bleeding
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Subject.ID,
    case_control_new,
    BMI_new,
    Age_new,
    Gravidity_new,
    stage_new,
    Severity_new,
    parity_status_new,
    Endosalpingiosis_new,
    Adenomyosis_new,
    Fibroids_new,
    paratubal_cysts_new,
    parity_new,
    pain_1st_level_new,
    abnormal_bleeding_new,
    Ethnicity,
    Race
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Subject.ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

merged_r = ps_join(merged_r, newdata, by = "Subject.ID", type = "left")

# Number of unique participants with both microbiome + pain data
n_distinct(sample_data(merged_r)$Subject.ID)

# Check that corrected demographics are still present after join
merged_meta_check = samdat_tbl(merged_r)

colnames(merged_meta_check)

table(merged_meta_check$case_control_new, useNA = "ifany")
summary(merged_meta_check$BMI_new)
summary(merged_meta_check$Age_new)
summary(merged_meta_check$parity_new)
table(merged_meta_check$Severity_new, useNA = "ifany")


merged_r <- merged_r %>%
  ps_filter(lib_size > 2000) %>%
  tax_filter(min_prevalence = 2)

merged_meta_r = samdat_tbl(merged_r)

merged_meta_r$case_control_new = as.factor(merged_meta_r$case_control_new)
merged_meta_r$case_control_new = relevel(merged_meta_r$case_control_new, ref = "control")
merged_meta_r$Fibroids_new = as.factor(merged_meta_r$Fibroids_new)
merged_meta_r$paratubal_cysts_new = as.factor(merged_meta_r$paratubal_cysts_new)
merged_meta_r$Endosalpingiosis_new = as.factor(merged_meta_r$Endosalpingiosis_new)
merged_meta_r$Adenomyosis_new = as.factor(merged_meta_r$Adenomyosis_new)
merged_meta_r$abnormal_bleeding_new = as.factor(merged_meta_r$abnormal_bleeding_new)

# Check for library size confounding
summary(merged_meta_r$lib_size)
hist(merged_meta_r$lib_size)
boxplot(merged_meta_r$lib_size ~ merged_meta_r$case_control_new, notch = F)
wilcox.test(merged_meta_r$lib_size ~ merged_meta_r$case_control_new)

# Rarefy
set.seed(123)
rare_r = rarefy_even_depth(merged_r, replace = F) # Rarefy to min depth or 2k, whichever greater
```

### Checking other diagnoses against Severity

```{r}
categorical_pvals <- tibble::tibble(
  Variable = c(
    "Adenomyosis",
    "Endosalpingiosis",
    "Fibroids",
    "Paratubal Cysts",
    "Abnormal Bleeding",
    "Race",
    "Ethnicity"
  ),
  p_value = c(
    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$Adenomyosis_new,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value,

    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$Endosalpingiosis_new,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value,

    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$Fibroids_new,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value,

    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$paratubal_cysts_new,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value,

    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$abnormal_bleeding_new,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value,

    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$Race,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value,

    fisher.test(table(merged_meta_r$Ethnicity,
                      merged_meta_r$Severity_new))$p.value
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

categorical_pvals

### Continous Summary
continuous_summary <- merged_meta_r %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Severity_new),
    Severity_new %in% c("Mild", "Severe")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Severity_new,
    Age_new,
    BMI_new,
    Gravidity_new,
    parity_new
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Age_new, BMI_new, Gravidity_new, parity_new),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variable, Severity_new) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sd = paste0(round(mean, 2), " ± ", round(sd, 2)),
    n = sum(!is.na(Value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

continuous_summary

continuous_pvals <- merged_meta_r %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Severity_new),
    Severity_new %in% c("Mild", "Severe")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Severity_new,
    Age_new,
    BMI_new,
    Gravidity_new,
    parity_new
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Age_new, BMI_new, Gravidity_new, parity_new),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ Severity_new)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

continuous_pvals
```

## Analyze samples by severity

```{r}
# Unmodified plot
rare_r = rare_r %>% tax_fix(unknowns = c("unclassified"))

sample_data(rare_r)$Subject.ID <- sample_names(rare_r)

sample_data(rare_r)$Severity_new <- merged_meta_r$Severity_new[
  match(sample_data(rare_r)$Subject.ID, merged_meta_r$Subject.ID)
]

table(sample_data(rare_r)$Severity_new, useNA = "ifany")

rare_r_severity <- rare_r %>%
  ps_filter(
    !is.na(Severity_new),
    Severity_new %in% c("Mild", "Severe")
  ) %>%
  tax_filter(min_prevalence = 1)

sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Severity_new <- factor(
  sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Severity_new,
  levels = c("Mild", "Severe")
)

table(sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Severity_new, useNA = "ifany")

severity_sample_order <- sample_names(rare_r_severity)

bar <- rare_r_severity %>% 
  comp_barplot(
    tax_level = "Genus",
    label = NULL,
    n_taxa = 20,
    taxon_renamer = function(x) stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " "),
    other_name = "Other genera",
    merge_other = FALSE,
    bar_width = 1,
    bar_outline_colour = "grey5",
    seriate_method = "OLO_ward",
    facet_by = "Severity_new",
    sample_order = severity_sample_order
  ) + 
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Stool samples",
    y = "Relative abundance",
    x = NULL,
    fill = "Genus"
  )

bar
```

### Alpha Diversity 

```{r}
set.seed(123)

metric_labels <- c(
  Observed = "Observed ASVs",
  Chao1 = "Chao1 Richness",
  Shannon = "Shannon Diversity Index",
  InvSimpson = "Inverse Simpson Index"
)

plot_richness(rare_r_severity, x="Severity_plot", measures=c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "InvSimpson")) + geom_boxplot()

rich_r <- estimate_richness(
  rare_r_severity,
  measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "InvSimpson")
)

rich_r$Severity_plot <- sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Severity_plot

rich_r <- rich_r %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.ID = sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Subject.ID,
    Severity_plot = sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Severity_plot
  )

rich_r <- rich_r %>%
  left_join(
    merged_meta_r %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Subject.ID,
        parity_new,
        parity_status_new,
        Gravidity_new,
        BMI_new,
        Age_new
      ),
    by = "Subject.ID"
  )

table(rich_r$Severity_plot)

alpha_results_severity <- tibble(
  Metric = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "InvSimpson"),
  Pvalue = c(
    wilcox.test(Observed ~ Severity_plot, data = rich_r)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Chao1 ~ Severity_plot, data = rich_r)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Severity_plot, data = rich_r)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(InvSimpson ~ Severity_plot, data = rich_r)$p.value
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "fdr"),
    p_label = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(Pvalue, 3))
  )

alpha_results_severity

plot_alpha_metric_severity <- function(metric_name) {
  
  p_value <- alpha_results_severity %>%
    filter(Metric == metric_name) %>%
    pull(Pvalue)
  
  p_lab <- bquote("Wilcoxon " * italic(p) == .(signif(p_value, 3)))
  
  ggplot(
    rich_r,
    aes(
      x = Severity_plot,
      y = .data[[metric_name]],
      fill = Severity_plot
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.75,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.85,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Mild (n = 11)" = "#FDBB84",
        "Severe (n = 10)" = "#990000"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 18, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 24, face = "bold"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_labels[[metric_name]],
      subtitle = p_lab
    )
}

p_observed_severity <- plot_alpha_metric_severity("Observed")
p_chao1_severity <- plot_alpha_metric_severity("Chao1")
p_shannon_severity <- plot_alpha_metric_severity("Shannon")
p_invsimpson_severity <- plot_alpha_metric_severity("InvSimpson")

p_observed_severity
p_chao1_severity
p_shannon_severity
p_invsimpson_severity
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

### Beta Diversity

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Match metadata to rare_r sample order
merged_meta_severity <- merged_meta_r %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subject.ID %in% sample_names(rare_r_severity)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Subject.ID, sample_names(rare_r_severity))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    samdat_tbl(rare_r_severity) %>%
      dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Severity_plot),
    by = "Subject.ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Severity_plot = factor(
      Severity_plot,
      levels = levels(sample_data(rare_r_severity)$Severity_plot)
    ),
    parity_status_new = factor(parity_status_new)
  )

stopifnot(all(merged_meta_severity$Subject.ID == sample_names(rare_r_severity)))

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Build distance matrices
# ----------------------------------------------------------

tree_r <- phy_tree(rare_r_severity)

otu_r <- as(otu_table(rare_r_severity), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(rare_r_severity)) {
  otu_r <- t(otu_r)
}

otu_r <- otu_r[merged_meta_severity$Subject.ID, ]

unifracs <- GUniFrac(
  otu.tab = otu_r,
  tree = tree_r,
  alpha = c(0, 0.5, 1)
)$unifracs

uni_dist <- as.dist(unifracs[, , "d_UW"])
guni_dist <- as.dist(unifracs[, , "d_0.5"])
wuni_dist <- as.dist(unifracs[, , "d_1"])

jac_dist <- vegdist(
  otu_r,
  method = "jaccard",
  binary = TRUE
)

bray_dist <- vegdist(
  otu_r,
  method = "bray"
)

### Prepare pseudocounts for aitchison
# Genus-level non-rarefied counts
merged_r_severity <- prune_samples(
  sample_names(rare_r_severity),
  merged_r
)

merged_r_genus <- tax_glom(merged_r_severity, taxrank = "Genus")

genus_counts <- as.data.frame(otu_table(merged_r_genus))

# Make sure rows = subjects and columns = taxa
if (taxa_are_rows(merged_r_genus)) {
  genus_counts <- as.data.frame(t(genus_counts))
}

# Add clean genus names as column names
genera <- as.data.frame(tax_table(merged_r_genus))
genus_names <- as.character(genera$Genus)
genus_names[is.na(genus_names) | genus_names == ""] <- "unclassified"
genus_names <- make.unique(genus_names)

colnames(genus_counts) <- genus_names

# CLR transform
genus_counts_pseudo <- genus_counts + 1
clr_mat <- compositions::clr(genus_counts_pseudo)

# Aitchison PCA
pca1 <- prcomp(clr_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
summary(pca1)

scores <- as.data.frame(pca1$x)
scores$Subject.ID <- rownames(scores)

# Aitchison distance
aitch <- vegan::vegdist(clr_mat, method = "euclidean")

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PERMANOVA
# ----------------------------------------------------------

uni_test <- adonis3(uni_dist ~ Severity_plot, data = merged_meta_severity)
guni_test <- adonis3(guni_dist ~ Severity_plot, data = merged_meta_severity)
jac_test <- adonis3(jac_dist ~ Severity_plot, data = merged_meta_severity)
wuni_test <- adonis3(wuni_dist ~ Severity_plot, data = merged_meta_severity)
bray_test <- adonis3(bray_dist ~ Severity_plot, data = merged_meta_severity)
aitch_test <- adonis3(aitch ~ Severity_plot, data = merged_meta_severity)


#### Beta Diversity Results  for case-control

beta_results <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "UniFrac",
    "Generalized UniFrac",
    "Jaccard",
    "Weighted UniFrac",
    "Bray-Curtis",
    "Aitchison Distance"
  ),
  R2 = c(
    uni_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "R2"],
    guni_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "R2"],
    jac_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "R2"],
    wuni_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "R2"],
    bray_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "R2"],
    aitch_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "R2"]
  ),
  Pvalue = c(
    uni_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "Pr(>F)"],
    guni_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "Pr(>F)"],
    jac_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "Pr(>F)"],
    wuni_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "Pr(>F)"],
    bray_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "Pr(>F)"],
    aitch_test$aov.tab["Severity_plot", "Pr(>F)"]
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "fdr")
  )

beta_results

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Plot settings
# ----------------------------------------------------------

severity_cols <- c(
  "Mild (n = 11)" = "#FDBB84",
  "Severe (n = 10)" = "#990000"
)

get_p <- function(metric_name) {
  signif(beta_results$Pvalue[beta_results$Metric == metric_name], 3)
}

get_adj_p <- function(metric_name) {
  signif(beta_results$FDR[beta_results$Metric == metric_name], 3)
}
```
